title: mcp: register the dataset tools on McpDataBridge under data:read (ADR-0149 D2)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ② a child card of an Accepted ADR. [ADR-0149](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md) D7 card 3. Parent: #31503, landed by PR #31535.
Reader: the `domain:server` lane (MCP bridge / runtime). It may run beside the service-analytics card once the bridge members are typed.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "McpDataBridge listDatasets registerDatasetTools" found nothing.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 让 MCP 客户端也能用同一对数据集工具：注册到 MCP，权限范围 `data:read`。
- **影响面：** MCP 新增两个工具，与产品内问数共用同一定义，口径一致。
- **需要您做的：** 无，由 server 车道实现。

## Task

- [ ] **D2:** optional members `McpDataBridge.listDatasets` / `.queryDataset`, implemented in both bridge implementations.
- [ ] `registerDatasetTools` in `wireBridgeTools`, under `data:read`.
- [ ] The skill prompt text that teaches the D3 selection rule to MCP clients.
